row: Living in Northern VA, Stafford, & Fredericksburg

The Give Back Team is a group of dedicated local Realtors in the Stafford and Northern Virginia area who believe in doing good! We want our clients to feel comfortable during the process when they Buy and Sell their homes, new construction, investment properties, and land.

We are highly skilled in getting our clients the best deal possible and have set records in doing so and love overdelivering wherever we can. We are proud to say we are the #1 Team for all of Coldwell Banker Elite.

We Social Responsibility to help the Communities that we live, work & play in. We volunteer in the Community Fundraising, providing resources & making contributions to local charities. We even donate back to the charity of our clients’ choice after closings.

Ginger Walker is a licensed real estate agent in the Commonwealth of Virginia. I serve as the Team Lead of Give Back Team with Coldwell Banker Elite 100 Parkway Blvd Stafford VA 22554 Visit www.GiveBackTeam.com
